minutes.headline: Master Plan committee heard the consultant's update: survey answers are at 336, with February 1 community sessions next.
minutes.summary: The consultant updated the committee on the second survey, the two February 1 sessions at the adult activity center, and how survey results will shape goals and later scenarios. Discussion covered low renter participation, adding a printable survey link, and separating open space for conservation from gathering space for the 300th anniversary. No formal votes besides adjournment were taken.

public_comment.topic: Asked whether the 2002 master plan is online, whether there was a survey response goal, and urged the plan to consider the Massachusetts clean energy and climate plan and Green Community standing.

votes.motion: Motion to adjourn, seconded, followed by roll call

budget_items.what_was_said: A speaker said losing Green Community good standing would make the town ineligible for state and federal grants for energy goals.

decisions.decision: The consultant agreed to post a PDF link to a printable survey on the plan website and send it to the committee.
The second survey's paper-return deadline was set for Thursday the 25th, three weeks out, so the data can be used at the February 1 sessions.
A member agreed to connect the consultant and staff with an apartment complex contact to reach renters, by email that night.
The consultant agreed to try to separate conservation open space from community gathering space in survey and follow-up work.
A member agreed to ask about getting the 2002 master plan posted online, though another member then said it is already in the document center.

what_happened.line: The Master Plan Steering Committee heard the consultant's update on a second survey, with two community sessions set for February 1.
The consultant agreed to post a link to a printable survey on the plan website and send it to the committee.
The second survey's paper-return deadline was set for Thursday the 25th so the data can be used at the February 1 sessions.
A member agreed to connect the consultant and staff with an apartment complex contact to reach renters, who are under-represented in responses.
The consultant agreed to try to separate conservation open space from community gathering space; no votes were taken apart from adjournment.

why_it_matters: The survey answers and the February 1 sessions feed the town's master plan goals and later scenarios, so residents who do not respond, renters especially, are less likely to be reflected in them.
watch_next: Paper survey returns are due Thursday the 25th, ahead of the two February 1 community sessions at the adult activity center.
